investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdshore Finance (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.101.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster verdsh-prod-eastus (AKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-01, maxmemory 16gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the limits-svc PostgreSQL database limits-db-01; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
